decodeahead.toggleAria: Turn decode-ahead for reverse playback on or off (opt-in experiment, via the S3 gate)
decodeahead.toggleHint: Decode-ahead prefetches the next reverse window ahead of time. It only turns on when the S3 gate allows it (easy-to-decode footage or proven hardware decode); turning it on mid-playback only takes effect from the next newly decoded window. The gate is only evaluated when turning on — a running controller is not switched off just because a later window measures slower; turning it off stops new prefetch and any in-flight prefetch is dropped when it settles.
decodeahead.toastBlocked: Decode-ahead blocked by the gate: {reasons}. It will retry at the next newly decoded window once a measurement exists.
decodeahead.toastOffNote: Decode-ahead is off: no new windows will be prefetched; any in-flight prefetch will be dropped when it settles.

reason.hardwareAbsent: no hardware decode on this machine
reason.softwareNotMeasured: no software decode measurement yet (play in reverse once to measure the first window)
reason.softwareBelowThreshold: software decode below the easy threshold (needs ≥ 2× playback fps)

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to VCut Studio
welcome.lead: A video editor that runs 100% on your machine: no uploads, no account, no AI fees.
welcome.step1Title: 1 · A video is ready on open
welcome.step1Body: A sample project is preloaded: press ▶ to play, drag clips on the timeline to try cutting and splitting.
welcome.step2Body: Pick a sample pack — media, text and sample captions are generated on your machine, no files to prepare.

tour.title: 🧭 5-step tour
tour.step1Body: Drag video/image/audio files into the Media library (left panel), or use its add-file button. Media stays on your machine.
tour.step2Body: On the timeline: click a clip, drag its edges to trim, press S at the playhead to split it in two.
tour.step3Body: Click “＋ Text” on the TopBar to add a text clip at the playhead, then edit content, size and color in the Properties panel.
tour.step4Body: Select a clip and open the Properties panel: video effects, color LUTs, masks and keyframes live there.
tour.step5Body: Click “Publish” on the TopBar, pick a preset and export: local FFmpeg renders an MP4 to your machine.
